name: 由气温与露点求相对湿度

map.由气温与露点，按 Magnus 关系反算相对湿度。: Back-calculate the relative humidity from air temperature and dew point via the Magnus relationship.
map.由气温与露点求相对湿度: Find the relative humidity from air temperature and dew point
map.📖 查看「相对湿度 RH 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Relative Humidity RH User Guide"
map.RH=100·exp[ aTd/(b+Td) − aT/(b+T) ]，Magn: RH=100·exp[ aTd/(b+Td) − aT/(b+T) ], derived from Magnus.
map.由干球与湿球温度（或露点）算: Compute from dry-bulb and wet-bulb temperature (or dew point)
map.由实际水汽压与饱和水汽压比值算 RH。: Compute RH as the ratio of actual to saturation vapor pressure.
map.校准湿度传感器用干湿球法。: Calibrate humidity sensors with the dry/wet bulb method.
map.干球 25°C、湿球 19°C、气压 1013 hPa → 查表/公式得 RH≈: Dry-bulb 25°C, wet-bulb 19°C, pressure 1013 hPa → table/formula gives RH ≈60%, consistent with the dew point method.
map.湿球和露点哪个准？: Which is more accurate, wet-bulb or dew point?
map.通风良好时湿球法稳；露点法在低温高湿更准，两者可互校。: The wet-bulb method is stable with good ventilation; the dew point method is more accurate at low temperature and high humidity; the two can cross-check each other.
map.过饱和可达 >100%（雾/云中），地面通常≤100，短暂超饱和称过饱和凝结核不: Supersaturation can exceed 100% (in fog/clouds); at the surface it is usually ≤100%; brief supersaturation is called insufficient condensation nuclei.
